name: create_support_ticket
description: Create or update a support ticket on a customer's account for an issue that cannot be resolved with the other tools. Attach order_id when the issue concerns a specific order.

body.description: Full description, in the customer's own terms where possible.

category.description: Which queue the ticket goes to. One of shipping, billing, product_defect, return_request or other.

order_id.description: Order the issue concerns, if any.

error_returns.when: The customer, or the named order, does not exist.
subject or body is empty, category is not an accepted value, or the order belongs to a different customer.
